newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March S&P 500 futures close higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March S&P 500 futures close higher.

text.p: March 3 - U.S. stock index futures ended up. March S&Ps recovered early from spillover bond weakness and closed near session highs. Traders said short-covering, tech rally, and early resilience all helped market late. Tuesday support at 786.00, resistance at Friday's high of 797.80, traders said.
